clause: StudioMask forms: grayscale / vector / clipping / compound / parametric-live [STU-RAS-015]

scope.summary: Implement the single canonical StudioMask primitive (14.23) in all five deduped forms attachable to any maskable layer or group: grayscale (paintable/fillable 8/16-bit alpha, created blank/from-selection/from-channel), vector (StudioVectorPath edges, convertible to/from pixel mask and combinable), clipping (base-layer alpha clips clipped layers), compound (boolean add/subtract/intersect/xor over multiple mask nodes), and parametric-live (auto-updating from image properties — Hue-Range, Luminosity-Range, Band-pass — staying re-editable). Vector masks consume the VectorEngine (MT-016).
acceptance_criteria: all 5 StudioMask forms attachable and re-editable
parametric masks auto-update; compound boolean ops work; vector<->pixel convert
proof_targets: five mask forms runtime + parametric-mask auto-update snapshot
expected_tests: live: attach each of the 5 mask forms to a layer; paint a grayscale mask and confirm reveal/hide; parametric luminosity-range mask auto-updates when underlying pixels change
live: compound mask combines two nodes via xor; vector mask converts to pixel mask losslessly-enough per spec
argus: mask thumbnail snapshot per form

target_entries: Studio / Raster / Masks: grayscale, vector, clipping, compound & live

risk_if_missed: No canonical masking; non-destructive reveal/hide and luminosity-masking workflows impossible.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
